ranked_evidence.snippet: LG Electronics to Shut Down Its First China Manufacturing Plant After 34 Years. ## Huizhou factory to end audio production this year as company streamlines manufacturing footprint. LG Electronics will halt production at its manufacturing plant in Huizhou, China, after October, bringing operations at the group's first manufacturing subsidiary in China to an end after 34 years. According to industry sources on July 21, LG Electronics plans to cease operations on the production lines at LG Electronics Huizhou (LGEHZ) by the end of the year. LGEHZ was established in October 1993 as a joint venture among LG Electronics, LG Electronics China and TCL Group, becoming the LG Group's first manufacturing subsidiary in China. "We plan to close the Huizhou plant this year and have already informed local employees that production will stop after October," a person involved in LG Electronics' China operations said. "Production at the Huizhou subsidiary is scheduled to stop by October this year," an LG Electronics spokesperson said.
